_comment: Synaptic-weight matrix-vector multiply — compute_synaptic_current on 10K post × 256 pre. I_post[j] = sum_i( W[j,i] * spike_pre[i] ) with early-out on zero spikes. Workgroup=256, dispatch=40. SHIMMED UNIFORM: SynapticParams = { pre_count: u32, post_count: u32, learning_rate: f32, _pad0: u32 } = 16 bytes. Hand-packed via uniform-u32-tuple with learning_rate=0.01 → 0x3c23d70a=1008981770. Pipeline layout:'auto' on compute_synaptic_current binds only the 4 declarations the function uses (params, weights, pre_spikes, post_currents); post_spikes @ (0,4) is declared in the module but is only consumed by stdp_weight_update, so it is omitted.
section: Synaptic current computation — sparse-friendly mat-vec product (post × pre) feeding the LIF integration step. Companion to paper-2-lif-step-10k.json which consumes synaptic_input downstream.
